_comment: Per-Article native-unit manifest for build/build-standalone.sh. Only Articles with native-Typst units need an entry; any article NOT listed (4-9) renders as pure markdown in a single pandoc pass. Per unit: typ (native file under source/), splice (after-prose | at-marker:<NAME>), data (--input data= value), conditional_on (path under source/ that must exist or the unit is skipped), parity (pad-to-odd-before = pad a blank so the unit's first page lands on a verso, e.g. Art-2 D1), pad_to (even-block = pad a trailing blank to keep an even block; only relevant mid-document, a no-op when the unit is last).
